title: bw-agent configuration
description: Variables read by bw-agent from the environment or from the private config file ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/bw-agent/<profile>.env (mode 600). Environment variables take precedence over the file. Selector variables (BW_AGENT_PROFILE, BW_AGENT_CONFIG, BW_AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONFIG) are environment-only and are listed under x-environment-only.

BW_SERVER.description: Base URL of any Bitwarden-compatible server (Bitwarden cloud US/EU, self-hosted Bitwarden, Vaultwarden). If unset, the server already configured in the bw CLI data dir is used.

BW_CLIENTID.description: Personal API key client_id (Web vault > Account settings > Security > Keys > View API key). Read natively by `bw login --apikey`.

BW_PASSWORD.description: Master password used to unlock the vault. Prefer BW_PASSWORD_FILE or BW_PASSWORD_COMMAND. Passed to bw via --passwordenv, never on the command line.

BW_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Path to a file (mode 600) whose first line is the master password.

BW_PASSWORD_COMMAND.description: Shell command that prints the master password on stdout (e.g. an OS keyring lookup). Only honoured from your own environment or your own mode-600 config file.

BW_BIN_DIR.description: Directory containing the bw binary (and node, for the npm build). Only needed when auto-detection fails, e.g. under cron/systemd.

BITWARDENCLI_APPDATA_DIR.description: Native bw CLI variable: data dir holding login state. Use a distinct dir per profile/server.

NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.description: Native Node.js variable: extra CA bundle (PEM) for self-hosted servers behind a private CA.

BW_AGENT_READ_ONLY.description: Block every write operation (create, edit, delete, restore, move, import, share, creating Sends).

BW_AGENT_ALLOW_EXPORT.description: Allow `bw export` (full vault dump). Blocked by default.

BW_AGENT_CACHE_DIR.description: Directory for the session-key cache and lock (mode 700). Default ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/bw-agent.

BW_AGENT_NO_CACHE.description: Do not persist the session key; unlock on every call (slower, nothing on disk).

BW_AGENT_LOCK_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds to wait for the re-authentication lock.

BW_AGENT_DEBUG.description: Print the bw CLI's login/unlock output (secrets masked) even when authentication succeeds. On failure it is always printed.

BW_HARD_RESET.description: Allow deleting the bw CLI data dir when re-login keeps failing. Destructive; only for on-disk corruption.

x-environment-only.BW_AGENT_PROFILE: Profile name ([A-Za-z0-9._-]+, default 'default'). Selects the config file and the session cache.
x-environment-only.BW_AGENT_CONFIG: Explicit path to the config file (overrides the profile-derived path).
x-environment-only.BW_AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONFIG: Set to 1 to accept a config file readable by group/others (not recommended).
x-environment-only.BW_AGENT_BIN: Python/integration layer only: explicit path to the bw-agent executable.
x-environment-only.BW_AGENT_TIMEOUT: Python/integration layer only: seconds before a bw-agent call is aborted (default 120).
